headline: GOLD DROPS BACK BELOW $4,000 AS JOLTS HITS 2-YEAR HIGH — 80%+ FED RATE HIKE ODDS; NFP REPORT THURSDAY
snippet: Gold spot fell below US$4,000 per ounce on July 2 — its lowest level in almost eight months — as U.S. JOLTS data showed May job openings climbing to 7.594 million, a two-year high that reinforced Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations, with CME FedWatch now pricing more than 80% odds of at least one hike before year-end. The move reversed Tuesday's Warsh-inspired 2% surge, returning gold to the contested $3,985–$4,010 range while silver retraced to approximately $59 per ounce. Thursday's June Non-Farm Payrolls report is the market's next major circuit-breaker: a soft number could extinguish September hike expectations and restart the precious metals recovery; a beat would likely push gold toward the $3,800–$3,900 structural support zone.

headline: WGC 'POINT BREAK': GOLD IN CRITICAL H2 2026 PHASE — RATE RISK VS ASIAN DEMAND; THREE PRICE SCENARIOS MAPPED
snippet: The World Gold Council's Gold Mid-Year Outlook 2026 — titled 'Point Break' and published July 1 — identifies H2 2026 as a pivotal phase with outcomes hinging on interest rate expectations, geopolitical conditions, and Asian investor sentiment, which now accounts for roughly 40% of daily gold price variability. Three scenarios are mapped: a hawkish-Fed case pushing gold toward $3,700–$3,900; a baseline rangebound case near $4,000–$4,300; and a risk-escalation or policy-pivot case reaccelerating toward $4,800 and beyond. Central bank buying is forecast to hold above the 600-tonne long-run average while bar and coin demand from Asia remains robust, with 89% of central bank survey participants expecting global central bank gold holdings to increase over the next 12 months.

headline: REFINED COPPER SPARED FROM 50% TARIFF FOR NOW — PHASED 15→30% DUTY RECOMMENDED FOR 2027-28; COMEX STOCKS HIT RECORD 650,000 TONNES
snippet: The U.S. Commerce Department submitted its Section 232 copper market update by the June 30 statutory deadline, recommending that refined copper remain excluded from the existing 50% tariff on semi-finished copper products, while proposing a phased tariff of 15% from January 2027 rising to 30% in 2028. The outcome has triggered a sharp reversal of the COMEX pre-positioning trade: inventories that surged from 80,000 to a record 650,000 tonnes over 10 months of pre-tariff hoarding must now be unwound, pushing COMEX copper to US$6.10/lb and down 8.2% for the month. Goldman Sachs projects copper could ultimately breach US$14,000/tonne once phased duties take effect — broadly bullish for long-term developers but creating near-term headwinds as the warehousing arbitrage unwinds.

headline: MACQUARIE FINDS MINERS PRICING GOLD AT $3,354 WHEN SPOT IS $4,156 — 40-QUARTER P/E LOW; $2,800/OZ RECORD MARGINS INVISIBLE TO MARKET
snippet: A GoldSeek analysis citing Macquarie Group research finds the current gold equity correction has opened a historically wide valuation gap: the average gold miner in Macquarie's coverage is pricing in US$3,354 per ounce — 19% below the current spot price of US$4,156 — while the trailing twelve-month P/E ratio across the top 25 GDX holdings has fallen to 20.2x, the lowest level in at least 40 consecutive quarters of sector-level tracking. This discount persists despite producers generating record AISC margins of approximately US$2,800 per ounce, with global average all-in sustaining costs projected to fall a further 5% this year against a 24% increase in the realized gold price — an earnings disconnect that has historically resolved through equity re-rating once macro headwinds stabilise.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING APOLLO GOES 300m DEEPER — NEW TUNGSTEN SUBZONE HITS 27.35m @ 37.55 g/t AUEQ (1.68% WO3, 11.62 g/t AU, 54 g/t AG) (TSX:CNL)
source_name: Investing News Network / Collective Mining Ltd.
snippet: Collective Mining Ltd. (TSX:CNL / NYSE:CNL) released results this week discovering a second, distinct tungsten-enriched high-grade subzone beginning 300 metres below surface at the Apollo breccia body, Guayabales Project, Caldas, Colombia — separate from the near-surface tungsten-rich zone spanning the top 100 metres. Drill hole APC-162 intersected 27.35 metres at 37.55 g/t gold equivalent (1.68% WO3, 11.62 g/t gold, 54 g/t silver, 0.43% copper) with visible coarse scheelite in core, and the new subzone remains open down-dip along the Apollo breccia's eastern contact margin. With 13 drill rigs turning as part of a planned 100,000-metre 2026 program and US$113.3 million in cash, follow-up drilling is imminent ahead of a maiden resource estimate targeted for H1 2027.

headline: MITHRIL COPALQUIN RESOURCE DERISKED: 615K OZ AUEQ WITH 75% INDICATED — MINE-CONSTRAINED MRE AT <$20/OZ DISCOVERY COST (TSXV:MSG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd.
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold Limited (TSXV:MSG / ASX:MTH) released a June 29 effective-date Mineral Resource Estimate upgrade for Target 1 at its Copalquin Project in Durango, Mexico, after approximately 60,000 metres of drilling across 204 holes. The updated MRE totals 615,000 ounces gold equivalent — 464,000 oz AuEq Indicated plus 151,000 oz AuEq Inferred — with 75% now in the higher-confidence Indicated category, a 196% increase in Indicated ounces vs. the prior estimate. Critically, the estimate is constrained using preliminary mining shapes incorporating expected dilution, providing a more realistic foundation for future economics; at under US$20 per ounce AuEq in total discovery cost, Mithril's exploration efficiency is among the best in the Mexico silver-gold developer peer group.

headline: LI-FT POWER YELLOWKNIFE PEGMATITES EXPAND — 17m @ 1.32% Li2O IN 5,324m WINTER PROGRAM; MULTIPLE ZONES CONFIRMED (TSXV:LIFT)
snippet: Li-FT Power Ltd. (TSXV:LIFT) reported June 30, 2026 results from 20 holes totalling 5,324 metres in the 2026 winter and 2025 summer programs at the Yellowknife Lithium Project in the Northwest Territories — the largest hard-rock lithium exploration project in Canada's north. Highlights include YLP-0320 with 17 metres at 1.32% Li2O in a 20-metre pegmatite dyke, YLP-0319 returning cumulative 19 metres at 1.22% Li2O across five dykes in a 59-metre corridor, and YLP-0321 hosting eight dykes over 100 metres. The results continue to build on the current 50.4 million-tonne at 1.00% Li2O (506,000 tonnes Li2O) Inferred Mineral Resource, with the geological model expanding across multiple target areas.

headline: ARGENTA SILVER EL QUEVAR POPS WITH 1,385 g/t AG OVER 4m — 22,000m DRILLED, 20+ NEW PRIORITY TARGETS DEFINED, DISTRICT FOOTPRINT EXPANDS (TSXV:AGAG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Argenta Silver Corp.
snippet: Argenta Silver Corp. (TSXV:AGAG) released June 30, 2026 exploration results from its El Quevar Project in Salta Province, Argentina — one of the largest undeveloped primary silver districts in South America. Drilling at the Mani-Copan target within the district returned 1,385 g/t silver over 4.0 metres with a 500 × 90 metre mineralised footprint confirmed across three mineralised levels; systematic geophysical coverage across the property has defined 20+ priority targets at varying stages of advancement. The Yaxtché Deposit footprint has been expanded by approximately 20% adding 270 metres of strike, with approximately 22,000 metres drilled since May 2025 and 40% of assays still pending — suggesting further significant intercepts to come in this active district.

headline: KODIAK COPPER 2.5× ITS MPD DRILL PROGRAM — 16,500m AND SECOND RIG ADDED; AI-ASSISTED TARGETING REVEALS 36 PORPHYRY PROSPECTS (TSXV:KDK)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kodiak Copper Corp.
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSXV:KDK) announced June 29, 2026 that its 2026 drill program at the 100%-owned MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia has been more than doubled — from an initial 6,500 metres to 16,500 metres — with a second diamond drill rig contracted to accelerate resource definition across all seven deposits in the Mineral Resource Estimate, each of which is open to expansion in multiple directions. The program has completed 2,546 metres in 14 holes to date at the Ketchan deposit, with a total of 36 prospective targets now identified across MPD including AI-assisted targets generated via VRIFY artificial intelligence prospecting — making this one of the most systematically targeted copper porphyry programs on the TSXV.

headline: SPROTT: URANIUM GATHERS H2 2026 MOMENTUM — KAZATOMPROM QUOTAS, AI-NUCLEAR DEMAND, AND ACCELERATING UTILITY TERM CONTRACTING CONVERGE
snippet: A Sprott analysis covered by The Northern Miner finds uranium positioned for H2 2026 momentum as three structural tailwinds converge: Kazatomprom maintaining reduced production quotas (9% increase this year but still well below its 100% subsoil-use capacity), accelerating AI data centre buildout driving tech company commitments to nuclear power purchase agreements, and utilities finally re-entering the term contract market after years of strategic under-coverage that has created visible procurement gaps for 2028–2032 delivery. The Sprott Physical Uranium Trust has added approximately 4 million pounds in 2026, bringing total holdings to nearly 79 million pounds, consistent with a long-term structural deficit thesis that deepens materially into the 2030s even with Kazatomprom's planned output growth.
